options.name: address
options.description: The address field in form "a.b.c.d/n" where the "/n" may be omitted. In this case, the CIDR value must be defined in the I(cidr) field. When reading, the I(address) field is always in the form "a.b.c.d".

options.name: cidr
options.description: The CIDR of the federated block. This is required, if I(address) does not specify it in its input.

options.name: comment
options.description: The description for the federated block. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the federated block. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags for the federated block in JSON format.
